items.problem: Department scores and tiers reduce to a fixed score contribution and an application-volume split instead of the required weighted performance rules.

items.source: final output ordered by department_performance_score DESC, then total_applications DESC
items.reason: The intended reporting order is missing in addition to the metric deficiencies.

items.problem: Applications and candidates are restricted by an extra upper date bound not present in the specified inclusive lower-bound window.
items.source: “Last 30 days” means on or after 30 calendar days before report_date, inclusive.
items.reason: Future-dated records are excluded here but included by the documented rule and the working dashboard implementation.

items.problem: Hire counting uses the application's opportunity_id even when the left join finds no corresponding opportunity.

items.reason: The existing predicates normally prevent unmatched rows from contributing, so this is a low-risk key-lineage check.
